clips.title: The story
paras: In Anvilmar, Bromos Grummner trains young dwarven paladins in the Holy Light. He teaches steadfast faith and the bond between dwarves and humans in the Knights of the Silver Hand.

In Anvilmar, Bromos Grummner welcomes dwarven novices to the discipline of the Holy Light. He teaches young paladins their martial rites and sacred invocations. Beyond combat, Bromos urges unity. The Knights of the Silver Hand bring Ironforge and the human kingdoms of the Alliance together in a shared righteous purpose.
